reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how units move and engage in battles. No more teleporting units or confusing formations! Check out our latest devtalk to learn about the new drag facing mechanics and how attacks now re-slot instead of wheeling through each other. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

posts: Exciting updates are here! Our new system for ranks that turn and march means more realistic and strategic battles. Learn more about the changes in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

Battles in Provincia just got an upgrade! Units now slide into formation without teleporting, and attacks are more strategic. Discover the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Battle Mechanics in Provincia: Ranks That Turn and March
steam.body: We're excited to introduce a new system for unit movement and combat in Provincia! Say goodbye to teleporting units and confusing formations. Our latest devtalk covers how units now slide into formation and how attacks re-slot instead of wheeling through each other. Check it out for a deeper understanding of these changes: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
